source.intent: Persistent rank selects complementary yielding/passing roles instead of both vehicles independently choosing opposite priorities. Unranked source peer is preferred; this does not authorize CBE to control it.

implementation: Shared read-only DrivingQueueCrossingVehicle is consumed before proposal rear-chain discovery and in canonical-current checks used by broker BEGIN/ACK/COMMIT/READY and actual owner VERIFY/COMMIT/HOLD. A sole participant meeting native BACK crew/turn prerequisites must yield; if both qualify the lexically first distinct network identity crosses. Neither qualifies or identity unknown/ambiguous returnsobjNull. Full consent/controller/route/task gates remain; no peer action follows a role observation.
cost: Two bounded crew/input/identity observations per selection, two-string sort only when both can reverse. No rank state, random reseeding, native movement, world query, handler or scheduler. Canonical-current reuses the selector but repeats these two input observations; no measured overhead claim.

validation.fullPipeline: Passed1476 existing tests and complete build gates; .qa/cbe-role-support-foundation-build.log

limits: Prerequisite-based role selection is not proof of native reverse capability or fair traffic scheduling. No admission against player/external-controller ownership is granted. Queue lateral guide, moving native phase, original-expiry binding, whole-hull crossing and handback remain incomplete; automatic initiation remains disabled. WholeHBQ parity remains unproven.
